title: HOKA Val d'Aran by UTMB — transport page
publisher: HOKA Val d'Aran by UTMB / UTMB World Series
claims: The UTMB-Bus connects almost all villages in the valley, from Les to Beret, with frequencies of 30 minutes to 1 hour and up to every 15 minutes at peak times.
VDA and EXP runners have free bus access without reservation; CDH, TDL and PDA runners must reserve a stop and time before 14 June; SKY runners must buy a ticket before 14 June.
The transport page is still the 2026 version: it says 'Looking ahead to 2026', gives 1–5 July dates and lists TDL on Wednesday 1 July, PDA on Thursday 2 July and SKY on Saturday 4 July.
For the VDA, a mountain shuttle to Artiga de Lin runs on Friday from 18:00 to 23:00, departing hourly from Vielha, in the 2026 timetable.
Runners who withdraw are evacuated to the finish in Vielha or to a point served by the UTMB-Bus or urban bus, free on presentation of the race bib and wristband.
After finishing, runners can use the UTMB-Bus free to return to the point where they started their journey.
